criteria.name: Exterior form and detail
criteria.evidence: Four-storey brick elevation, repeated southeast glazing and glass-roof penthouse remain readable. R10 added no exterior form/facade detail; other elevations, base, roof edges and exact 44-pane placement remain simplified or unverified.

criteria.name: Materials and texturing
criteria.evidence: Lighter blue-gray curtain-wall shader and coherent brick/reveal variation. Through-glass image still has strong reflection and bright softbox highlight; glass color/specification is not measured.

criteria.name: Interior completeness
criteria.evidence: Five schematic platforms and six rising rows improve tier readability; source supports fixed tiered tables, a lectern and dual projectors. Central/front wall still blocks much of the room; projector surfaces are not evident in the submitted view; 42 modeled desk objects versus 62 seats listed by the 2023 guide; full room boundary and route to atrium/core are not established.

criteria.name: Technical integrity and placement
criteria.evidence: Independent Blender 5.2.3 reopen exact hash: 735 scene/collection objects, 727 meshes, identity root, 18 used materials, zero materialless/invalid-slot meshes, missing images, linked libraries or >120m mesh-bound outliers. Independent BVH checks: 44/44 pane-center rays clear exterior shell and 44/44 clear tested 1086 wall. Center rays do not prove all-view visibility; master marker/neighborhood unreviewed.

criteria.name: Evidence and source fit
criteria.evidence: R10 handoff records exact hash, source URLs/access date, validation and uncertainties. Purdue 2023 guide lists 62 seats, fixed tiered tables, lectern and dual projectors; room page lists occupancy 136; 2024 plan is first-floor only. Tier rise and 1m plan-shell registration remain approximate.

findings: R10 improves on R9's absent tiered-room cues by adding five low platforms and six seating rows, plus a schematic lectern and dual screens.
The submitted through-glass view remains partly occluded by a central/front wall and bright reflection; teaching equipment is not clearly legible from the normal view.

The Purdue 2023 room guide lists 62 seats. There are 42 modeled desk objects, so the model is not a complete count/layout for that source. The R10 handoff correctly does not equate the separate 136 occupancy figure with seats.
Exterior quality is essentially unchanged from R9. The 44-pane pattern remains model-inherited, not dimension-verified.
Plan-to-shell registration remains uncertain by about 1m; master placement and surrounding campus context were not checked.

sources.title: Purdue RAWL 1086 Classroom Guide (2023)
sources.notes: Page 1 lists fixed tiered tables, 62 seats and dual projectors; page 2 describes lectern.

limitations: Standalone asset grade does not inspect the master placement marker or neighborhood.
R10's 42 desks are explicitly schematic; 2023 room guide lists 62 seats.
Tier heights and dimensions are not sourced; plan-to-shell registration remains about 1m uncertain.
Pane locations and widths are inherited from existing model, not independently surveyed.
Upper-floor partitions, atrium circulation and current interior finishes remain unverified.
